name: Los Angeles Police Department
summary: L.A. Police Dept. is an action-packed game where you play as a police officer in Los Angeles, battling hostile gangsters. The camera moves automatically while you control the crosshairs of your UZI to take down enemies. Ammunition is scarce but can be collected from gangsters along with body armor. Your energy decreases if you are hit or if innocent civilians are injured in the crossfire. Precision and caution are essential to making the streets safe.
